summary: In this installment of Zadul-Ma'ad (Provisions for the Hereafter), Sheikh Ali Mashhour discusses the Islamic etiquette and rulings regarding eating and drinking. The lecture covers the obligation of saying Bismillah (In the name of Allah) before eating, whether it is an individual or collective obligation, and the proper manner of drinking. Sheikh explains that saying Bismillah is obligatory on each individual person, supported by the hadith of the man who joined the Prophet and companions at a meal without saying Bismillah, resulting in insufficient food. The lecture also explores the Islamic legal concept of individual versus collective obligations (Fard Ain vs. Fard Kifayah) using various examples including prayer recitation behind an imam and responding to greetings.

catchy_title: Why Must Each Person Say Bismillah?
